sentences.text: 4. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the petitioner is in custody since 02.12.2022 and as investigation has progressed substantially, he may be released on bail.
5. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for bail during the currency of investigation.

6. Perused the 164 Cr.P.C. statement of the victim.
7.

opennyai_summary.facts:
2. The petitioner is an accused in C.T. Case No.67 of 2022, pending in the file of learned Additional District & Sessions-cum- Special Judge (POCSO), Phulbani, arising out of Tumudibandha P.S. Case No.97 of 2022, for commission of alleged offences under Sections 366/376(2)(n)/506 of IPC read with Section 6 of POCSO Act.
3. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned Additional District & Sessions Judge-cum-Special Judge (POCSO), Phulbani by order dated 15.12.2022 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.
opennyai_summary.decision:
4. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the petitioner is in custody since 02.12.2022 and as investigation has progressed substantially, he may be released on bail.
Considering the same, this Court directs the petitioner to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin so as to ensure his presence on each date of trial.
Additionally, it is directed that the petitioner shall appear before the I.O. once every week on such date and time to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin till submission of final form.
9. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
10. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per the rules.
